turns.teacher: Good morning children. Sit down quietly, take out your slates. Today we are doing subtraction.
turns.label: other

turns.teacher: Write this on your slate. Fifty two minus twenty seven. 52-27. Quickly.
turns.label: new_sum

turns.teacher: Rabi, you wrote 35? No no, wrong. Answer is 25. Write 25 and keep it.
turns.label: tell_answer

turns.teacher: Arjoon, 35 also? I told you already. 2 is small, you cannot take 7, so take one ten. Take one ten! Listen properly this time.
turns.label: repeat_same_way

turns.teacher: Mina, 26 is wrong. Not careful at all. Sit and listen, next time be careful.
turns.label: move_on_or_scold

turns.teacher: Everybody say with me: fifty two minus twenty seven is twenty five. Again, twenty five.
turns.label: tell_answer

turns.teacher: Now next one. Sixty one minus thirty eight. 61-38. Do it fast.
turns.label: new_sum

turns.teacher: Answer is 23. Who got 23? Thumbs up. Okay, those who didn't get it, just copy 23 from the board.
turns.label: check_whole_class

turns.teacher: Enough for now. Close your slates and put them in your bags. We will do more tomorrow.
turns.label: other
